effect.name: FXAA Fast Approximate Anti-Aliasing (Switch)
effect.description: The shader smooths pixel edges using Fast Approximate Anti-Aliasing (FXAA).
effect.author: Foxioo (Special thanks to Jasper Flick)

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's FXAA Fast Approximate Anti-Aliasing (Switch) Shader | 2026.08.27 */
parameter.description: The shader smooths pixel edges using Fast Approximate Anti-Aliasing (FXAA).

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable determines what the base should be. Setting it to 0 sets the base as the texture of the object on which the effect is applied, and setting it to 1 sets this as the background.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Threshold
parameter.description: This variable specifies the brightness threshold at which anti-aliasing should be applied.

parameter.name: Relative
parameter.description: This variable determines how high the contrast needs to be for anti-aliasing to work.

parameter.name: Pixel Offset
parameter.description: This variable specifies the pixel offset used to retrieve information about surrounding pixels.
